calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 9 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales, COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
       (SELECT SUM(c.net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date cd ON cd.calendar_date=c.business_date
         WHERE c.store_id=900 AND cd.fiscal_year=d.fiscal_year AND cd.fiscal_period=d.fiscal_period) AS control
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT 'dup_sales_lines' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-20' AND DATE '2026-01-30' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-20' AND DATE '2026-01-30' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_return_lines', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_lines_not_dispatched', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected') WHERE s.store_id=900 AND o.web_order_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_test_lines', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_channel_wb_not900', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND s.store_id<>900
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_web_orders', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
